$comment: Direction: Rust to Swift. Exactly one grounded sentence explaining the block's most recent shown intervention. Deterministic code selects the claim, evidence, and tone from the stored intervention record under the grounded-language rules; the sentence cannot exceed that evidence, and Swift renders it verbatim with no reply affordance. One sentence by contract — a second sentence, question, or thread is structurally out of scope (D7). Local IPC surface only — never uploaded.
